beyond.label: PHP line coverage
beyond.why: SIG rates no tests. Coverage shows how much of the code a unit or integration test runs.
beyond.basis: Heitlager, Kuipers and Visser 2007: unit test coverage ++ 95-100%, + 80-95%, o 60-80%, - 20-60%, -- 0-20%

beyond.label: spec coverage (gate 16)
beyond.why: Share of in-scope methods that name the spec they implement, so a change can be traced to a requirement.
beyond.basis: our choice: Heitlager's coverage bands applied to traceability

beyond.label: e2e scenario coverage (gate 19)
beyond.why: Share of non-excluded spec scenarios a running Playwright test cites: the behaviour a user sees is proven.
beyond.basis: our choice: Heitlager's coverage bands applied to spec scenarios

beyond.label: test code ratio
beyond.why: SIG's own test volume figure (test LOC / production LOC), shown in Sigrid without stars.
beyond.basis: Sigrid: a 100% test code ratio is roughly 80% coverage, so Heitlager's 95/80/60/20% coverage bands become 120/100/75/25% test code

beyond.label: baselined findings per kLOC PHP
beyond.why: psalm, phpstan and phpmd baselines hide findings from the gates. Each entry is debt a reviewer no longer sees.
beyond.basis: our own bands; no published benchmark

beyond.label: suppressions per kLOC
beyond.why: Inline @psalm-suppress, @phpstan-ignore, @SuppressWarnings, phpcs:ignore and eslint-disable silence a tool where SIG still counts the code.
beyond.basis: our own bands; no published benchmark

beyond.label: security gate findings
beyond.why: Gates 5-9, 11, 30, 48, 50, 82, 97 and 121 find missing auth, IDOR and fail-open checks that SAST tools do not know about Nextcloud.
beyond.basis: our own bands; 0 is the only passing state of each gate

beyond.label: vulnerable dependencies, high or critical
beyond.why: composer audit and npm audit on the lockfiles; SIG rates the same CVEs in Open Source Health.
beyond.basis: SIG Open Source Health: 4 stars means no vulnerability above moderate; 5 stars also no moderate

beyond.label: unmanaged dependencies
beyond.why: Third-party code committed into the repository (minified or vendored files) gets no security updates.
beyond.basis: SIG Open Source Health: 4 stars at most 6% unmanaged; 3 and 2 stars double that

beyond.label: accessibility findings per .vue file
beyond.why: SIG has no accessibility model. Gates 12 and 31-45 check WCAG 2.2 AA rules in the source.
beyond.basis: our own bands; WCAG 2.2 AA asks for none

beyond.label: UI convention findings
beyond.why: The UI gates keep every app on the shared nextcloud-vue patterns, so users meet one interface.
beyond.basis: our own bands; 0 is the only passing state of each gate

rows.label: PHP coverage (coverage-guard)
rows.what: line coverage the PHP suite may not drop below

rows.label: test coverage ratchet
rows.what: suite coverage per runner, raised on every gain

rows.label: debt ratchet
rows.what: suppressions and ignores counted by check:debt-ratchet
